name: Robot Lawn Mower Specs & Scores
description: Open, cited dataset of wire-free and RTK robot lawn mowers: navigation, coverage, slope, cutting specs, dated prices (the seller's live price and stock wherever the seller publishes machine-readable product data) and a transparent 0-5 BestRobotMower Score. Compiled by BestRobotMower.co.
attribution: BestRobotMower.co: Robot Lawn Mower Specs & Scores (CC BY 4.0), https://bestrobotmower.co/dataset
